name: Aquatic Adventure
author: stlthmstr
description:
Your crystal scanner has detected 21 unique energy signatures in a strange underwater area.
As you investigate the signals, beware of territorial sharks and other colossal sea creatures.
Explore submarine bases, undiscovered ruins, giant fossils, sunken ships, legendary castles and more!


Featuring:
-A large, open aquascape to traverse, full of relaxing sights and sounds
-Hundreds of lively aquatic animals like colorful fish, sharks, and jellyfish, to name a few
-Procedurally-generated content including flora, fauna, and other elements
-Secret areas for you to find
-Hidden scuba gear upgrades to collect, including something to help you search higher places
-Several unlockable vehicles to pilot, in addition to your undersea scooter
-Many interactive pieces secretly dispersed to test your knowledge of classic sets


Player Controls:
-Move your character with ‘WASD’ keys
-Look around by moving your mouse
-Jump with the space bar
-Press ‘E’ to interact with certain objects
-Scuba suit upgrades will reveal additional controls if unlocked


Vehicle Controls:
-Vehicles are steered by looking in the direction you want go with your mouse
-Simply stand on a vehicle to start accelerating
-No need to worry, vehicles have automatic collision avoidance too
-After unlocking a new vehicle, a visual cue will display where to stand to control it


Links:
-PC Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1vB-vpf8BAvZoHCg0ihGkbD4bb2_TbUPD/view?usp=sharing


I hope you enjoy my oceanic game! How many secrets have you found so far?


Note:
-The Unity Play build will take a while to load the first time. This is a highly-detailed microgame, which runs reasonably on WebGL using modern hardware, including a dedicated GPU.
-If you are on a Windows computer, and want a better experience, please try the PC download linked above.


Thank you for playing!
